description: This file contains extension methods for the Assembly class, facilitating the identification and retrieval of loadable INinjectModule implementations within an assembly. It is used to integrate Ninject dependency injection modules dynamically based on assembly contents.

classes.name: AssemblyExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for the Assembly class to check for and retrieve loadable Ninject modules.

methods.name: HasNinjectModules
methods.description: Checks if an assembly contains any loadable INinjectModule types.

methods.name: GetNinjectModules
methods.description: Retrieves all loadable INinjectModule instances from an assembly.
